subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half has shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug has a clear source-level failure shape, but the linked branches are conflicting or stale and choosing adoption, replacement, or closure requires maintainer ownership judgment.

options.title: Replace With Focused Fix
options.body: Sponsor a narrow replacement that records routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and proves cron/heartbeat wakes post into the originating thread.

options.title: Adopt Existing Candidate
options.body: Pick one linked PR, rebase it, address the wrong-route and proof risks, and make it the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close Remaining Scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is not supported.

recommendation.title: Replace With Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow replacement that records routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and proves cron/heartbeat wakes post into the originating thread.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most recent adjacent Mattermost route/threading history and were involved in the shipped partial fix.
